passages.text:
**Sam Reyes turns operations data into decisions for people who do not read SQL.** They work at
Fieldline Logistics, where their delivery-delay dashboard is used by every regional manager. They took eighteen months off work between 2021 and 2023 to care for a family member, and returned
through a data analytics bootcamp.

They have not built machine learning models in production. Their forecasting is statistical, in
SQL and Python, not neural networks. They have no published research. They do not manage people.

Role: Data Analyst. September 2023 to present. Austin, TX. Stack: SQL, BigQuery, dbt, Looker, Python
Measured: 14 regional managers using the delay dashboard weekly; -11% late deliveries in the first two quarters after the dashboard; 6 hours weekly reporting time saved
They built the delivery-delay dashboard in Looker over BigQuery. Late deliveries fell 11 percent in
the two quarters after regional managers started using it. They automated the weekly operations report with dbt and scheduled queries, saving about six hours
of manual work every week.

Role: Inventory Coordinator. March 2018 to August 2021. Austin, TX. Stack: Excel, Google Sheets
They ran inventory for a grocery co-op with two stores and kept the ordering spreadsheets that
later became their first data project: a demand forecast that cut produce waste by 18 percent.

Role: Family caregiver. September 2021 to March 2023. Austin, TX. A planned break to care for a family member. During it they completed the Google Data Analytics
certificate.
Data Analytics Bootcamp, Austin Coding Academy, 2023. Bachelor of Arts in Economics, Texas State University, 2017.

Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate, 2022.

dbt Fundamentals, dbt Labs, 2024.
Languages: SQL, Python, R. Tools: BigQuery, dbt, Looker, Tableau, Excel. Methods: forecasting, A/B test analysis, cohort analysis.

Available now. Looking for analyst or analytics engineer roles in operations or logistics. Austin
or remote in the United States.
